name: CleanBrowsing Free DNS Filters
free_limit: Three free preset hosted DNS resolvers (Family, Adult and Security filters) with IPv4/IPv6, DNS-over-HTTPS and DNS-over-TLS; no account, subscription or payment card needed.
watch_out: Free filters are throttled and non-customizable, with no account dashboard, reporting, per-domain allow/block rules or support. Provider states free service is for parents rather than organizations; business/managed-network plans cost extra.
